description: This PHP source file defines the class RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor, which handles processing termination events for employees within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract class and uses traits to interact with employee services, fetching employee count data to generate event-related information.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing employee termination events, specifically counting inactive employees and determining if an event should be triggered based on employee count thresholds.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the specific event type identifier for inactive employee count events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of registration event data, including the count of past employees.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether a new event should be saved based on employee count thresholds and change tracking size.
